+++ b//tmp/wall01-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+

+const state = createEncounter({
+  bounds: { columns: 15, rows: 8 },
+  combatants: [actor],
+  tokens: [placedToken(actor, 14, 7)],
+  blockedCells: [
+    { column: 7, row: 2 }, { column: 7, row: 3 },
+    { column: 8, row: 4 }, { column: 8, row: 5 },
+  ],
+});
+for (const [from, to] of [
+  [{ column: 12, row: 3 }, { column: 0, row: 3 }],
+  [{ column: 12, row: 4 }, { column: 0, row: 4 }],

+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ from, to, sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner, tier: trace.tier,

+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner, tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));
+}
+

+  blockedCells: [{ column: 3, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 3 }],

+console.log(JSON.stringify({ shifted: true, tier: shiftedTrace.tier, blocksSight: shiftedTrace.blocksSight,
+  firstBlockingCell: shiftedTrace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: shiftedTrace.sourceCorner }));
+
+for (const blockedCells of [
+  [{ column: 1, row: 0 }, { column: 0, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 1, row: 2 }],
+  [
+    { column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 },
+    { column: 1, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 2 },
+  ],

+  const crack = createEncounter({
+    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 }, combatants: [actor], tokens: [placedToken(actor, 4, 4)], blockedCells,
+  });
+  const trace = traceTerrainLine(crack, { column: 0, row: 0 }, { column: 3, row: 3 });
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ blockedCells, tier: trace.tier, blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    firstBlockingCell: trace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));
+}

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,

+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),

+

+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+function greatestCommonDivisor(left: number, right: number): number {

+  let divisor = Math.abs(right);

+    dividend = divisor;
+    divisor = remainder;
+  }

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+}

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-generation.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { createEncounter } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/combat/encounter';
+import { traceTerrainLine } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/combat/cover';
+import { placedToken, playerProfile } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/tests/unit/combat/fixtures';
+
+const actor = playerProfile('wall-probe');
+const state = createEncounter({
+  bounds: { columns: 15, rows: 8 },
+  combatants: [actor],
+  tokens: [placedToken(actor, 14, 7)],
+  blockedCells: [
+    { column: 7, row: 2 }, { column: 7, row: 3 },
+    { column: 8, row: 4 }, { column: 8, row: 5 },
+  ],
+});
+for (const [from, to] of [
+  [{ column: 12, row: 3 }, { column: 0, row: 3 }],
+  [{ column: 12, row: 4 }, { column: 0, row: 4 }],
+] as const) {
+  const trace = traceTerrainLine(state, from, to);
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ from, to, sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner, tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: trace.firstBlockingCell,
+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner, tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));
+}
+
+const shifted = createEncounter({
+  bounds: { columns: 6, rows: 6 }, combatants: [actor], tokens: [placedToken(actor, 5, 5)],
+  blockedCells: [{ column: 3, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 3 }],
+});
+const shiftedTrace = traceTerrainLine(shifted, { column: 0, row: 0 }, { column: 4, row: 4 });
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ shifted: true, tier: shiftedTrace.tier, blocksSight: shiftedTrace.blocksSight,
+  firstBlockingCell: shiftedTrace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: shiftedTrace.sourceCorner }));
+
+for (const blockedCells of [
+  [{ column: 1, row: 0 }, { column: 0, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 1, row: 2 }],
+  [
+    { column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 },
+    { column: 1, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 2 },
+  ],
+]) {
+  const crack = createEncounter({
+    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 }, combatants: [actor], tokens: [placedToken(actor, 4, 4)], blockedCells,
+  });
+  const trace = traceTerrainLine(crack, { column: 0, row: 0 }, { column: 3, row: 3 });
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ blockedCells, tier: trace.tier, blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    firstBlockingCell: trace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));
+}

+function greatestCommonDivisor(left: number, right: number): number {
+  let dividend = Math.abs(left);
+  let divisor = Math.abs(right);
+  while (divisor !== 0) {
+    const remainder = dividend % divisor;
+    dividend = divisor;
+    divisor = remainder;
+  }
+  return dividend;
+}
+
+function firstSharedVertexBlockingHit(
+  from: CornerPoint,
+  to: CornerPoint,
+  sightBlockingAt: (cell: GridCell) => boolean,
+): SightBlockingHit | null {
+  if (![from.column, from.row, to.column, to.row].every(Number.isInteger)) return null;
+  const columnDelta = to.column - from.column;
+  const rowDelta = to.row - from.row;
+  const latticeSteps = greatestCommonDivisor(columnDelta, rowDelta);
+  if (latticeSteps <= 1) return null;
+  const columnStep = columnDelta / latticeSteps;
+  const rowStep = rowDelta / latticeSteps;
+  // Indices exclude t=0 and t=1: endpoint vertices are governed only by cell-interior crossing.
+  for (let index = 1; index < latticeSteps; index += 1) {
+    const column = from.column + columnStep * index;
+    const row = from.row + rowStep * index;
+    const topLeft = { column: column - 1, row: row - 1 };
+    const topRight = { column, row: row - 1 };
+    const bottomLeft = { column: column - 1, row };
+    const bottomRight = { column, row };
+    const pairCells = [
+      ...(sightBlockingAt(topLeft) && sightBlockingAt(bottomRight)
+        ? [topLeft, bottomRight]
+        : []),
+      ...(sightBlockingAt(topRight) && sightBlockingAt(bottomLeft)
+        ? [topRight, bottomLeft]
+        : []),
+    ].sort(compareCells);
+    const first = pairCells[0];
+    // Within either diagonal pair, choose lower row then lower column; all-four ties use the same order.
+    if (first !== undefined) return { cell: first, progress: index / latticeSteps };
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function cellInteriorEntryProgress(from: CornerPoint, to: CornerPoint, cell: GridCell): number {
+  let entry = 0;
+  const columnDelta = to.column - from.column;
+  if (columnDelta !== 0) {
+    entry = Math.max(entry, Math.min(
+      (cell.column - from.column) / columnDelta,
+      (cell.column + 1 - from.column) / columnDelta,
+    ));
+  }
+  const rowDelta = to.row - from.row;
+  if (rowDelta !== 0) {
+    entry = Math.max(entry, Math.min(
+      (cell.row - from.row) / rowDelta,
+      (cell.row + 1 - from.row) / rowDelta,
+    ));
+  }
+  return entry;
+}
+
+function firstSightBlockingCell(
+  from: CornerPoint,
+  to: CornerPoint,
+  interveningCells: readonly GridCell[],
+  sightBlockingAt: (cell: GridCell) => boolean,
+): GridCell | null {
+  const hits: SightBlockingHit[] = interveningCells
+    .filter(sightBlockingAt)
+    .map((cell) => ({ cell, progress: cellInteriorEntryProgress(from, to, cell) }));
+  const edge = firstSharedEdgeBlockingHit(from, to, sightBlockingAt);
+  if (edge !== null) hits.push(edge);
+  const vertex = firstSharedVertexBlockingHit(from, to, sightBlockingAt);
+  if (vertex !== null) hits.push(vertex);
+  // One traversal order covers interior entry, shared-edge entry, then strict-interior lattice vertices.
+  // Events are ordered by segment progress; simultaneous events use lower row, then lower column.
+  hits.sort((left, right) => left.progress - right.progress || compareCells(left.cell, right.cell));
+  const first = hits[0];
+  return first === undefined ? null : { ...first.cell };
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c58bfbaf9c69f0c39750c050f6c84455359dd634
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}
diff --git a//tmp/wall01-generation.ts b//tmp/wall01-generation.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cf9918a28b3a2e76450b0b0ff2d8e9f0d19aa03a
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-generation.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { createEncounter } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/combat/encounter';
+import { traceTerrainLine } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/combat/cover';
+import { placedToken, playerProfile } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/tests/unit/combat/fixtures';
+
+const actor = playerProfile('wall-probe');
+const state = createEncounter({
+  bounds: { columns: 15, rows: 8 },
+  combatants: [actor],
+  tokens: [placedToken(actor, 14, 7)],
+  blockedCells: [
+    { column: 7, row: 2 }, { column: 7, row: 3 },
+    { column: 8, row: 4 }, { column: 8, row: 5 },
+  ],
+});
+for (const [from, to] of [
+  [{ column: 12, row: 3 }, { column: 0, row: 3 }],
+  [{ column: 12, row: 4 }, { column: 0, row: 4 }],
+] as const) {
+  const trace = traceTerrainLine(state, from, to);
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ from, to, sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner, tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: trace.firstBlockingCell,
+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner, tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));
+}
+
+const shifted = createEncounter({
+  bounds: { columns: 6, rows: 6 }, combatants: [actor], tokens: [placedToken(actor, 5, 5)],
+  blockedCells: [{ column: 3, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 3 }],
+});
+const shiftedTrace = traceTerrainLine(shifted, { column: 0, row: 0 }, { column: 4, row: 4 });
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ shifted: true, tier: shiftedTrace.tier, blocksSight: shiftedTrace.blocksSight,
+  firstBlockingCell: shiftedTrace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: shiftedTrace.sourceCorner }));
+
+for (const blockedCells of [
+  [{ column: 1, row: 0 }, { column: 0, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 1, row: 2 }],
+  [
+    { column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 },
+    { column: 1, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 2 },
+  ],
+]) {
+  const crack = createEncounter({
+    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 }, combatants: [actor], tokens: [placedToken(actor, 4, 4)], blockedCells,
+  });
+  const trace = traceTerrainLine(crack, { column: 0, row: 0 }, { column: 3, row: 3 });
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ blockedCells, tier: trace.tier, blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    firstBlockingCell: trace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));
+}

+function greatestCommonDivisor(left: number, right: number): number {
+  let dividend = Math.abs(left);

+    dividend = divisor;
+    divisor = remainder;
+  }

+  const rowDelta = to.row - from.row;
+  const latticeSteps = greatestCommonDivisor(columnDelta, rowDelta);
+  if (latticeSteps <= 1) return null;
+  const columnStep = columnDelta / latticeSteps;
+  const rowStep = rowDelta / latticeSteps;
+  // Indices exclude t=0 and t=1: endpoint vertices are governed only by cell-interior crossing.
+  for (let index = 1; index < latticeSteps; index += 1) {
+    const column = from.column + columnStep * index;
+    const row = from.row + rowStep * index;
+    const topLeft = { column: column - 1, row: row - 1 };
+    const topRight = { column, row: row - 1 };
+    const bottomLeft = { column: column - 1, row };
+    const bottomRight = { column, row };
+    const pairCells = [
+      ...(sightBlockingAt(topLeft) && sightBlockingAt(bottomRight)

+    if (first !== undefined) return { cell: first, progress: index / latticeSteps };

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c58bfbaf9c69f0c39750c050f6c84455359dd634
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,

+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c58bfbaf9c69f0c39750c050f6c84455359dd634
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}
diff --git a//tmp/wall01-generation.ts b//tmp/wall01-generation.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cf9918a28b3a2e76450b0b0ff2d8e9f0d19aa03a
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-generation.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

function traceSpaces(

    ? [...indexedSources.values()]

+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

    !exclusions.has(cellKey(cell)) && sourcesAt(cell).some((source) => source.tier === 'total');
  const traces = outerCorners([from]).map((sourceCorner) => aggregateCornerLines(
    sourceCorner,
    targetCorners.map((targetCorner) => traceCornerLine(
      sourceCorner,
      targetCorner,
      candidates,
      sourcesAt,
      sightBlockingAt,
    )),
    sourceCell,
    targetCell,
  ));
  const first = traces[0];
  if (first === undefined) throw new RangeError('A line query requires non-empty source and target spaces.');
  return traces.reduce((best, candidate) =>
    comparePhysicalCornerTraces(candidate, best) < 0 ? candidate : best, first).tier;
}

export type CreatureCoverOptions = CreatureLineOptions;

export interface CombatantCoverResult {
  readonly tier: CoverTier;
  readonly sourceIds: readonly string[];
}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c58bfbaf9c69f0c39750c050f6c84455359dd634
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c58bfbaf9c69f0c39750c050f6c84455359dd634
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+    { column: 8, row: 4 }, { column: 8, row: 5 },
+  ],

+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner, tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));

+

+  blockedCells: [{ column: 3, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 3 }],
+});
+const shiftedTrace = traceTerrainLine(shifted, { column: 0, row: 0 }, { column: 4, row: 4 });
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ shifted: true, tier: shiftedTrace.tier, blocksSight: shiftedTrace.blocksSight,
+  firstBlockingCell: shiftedTrace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: shiftedTrace.sourceCorner }));
+
+for (const blockedCells of [
+  [{ column: 1, row: 0 }, { column: 0, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 1, row: 2 }],
+  [
+    { column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 },
+    { column: 1, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 2 },
+  ],
+]) {
+  const crack = createEncounter({
+    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 }, combatants: [actor], tokens: [placedToken(actor, 4, 4)], blockedCells,
+  });
+  const trace = traceTerrainLine(crack, { column: 0, row: 0 }, { column: 3, row: 3 });
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ blockedCells, tier: trace.tier, blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    firstBlockingCell: trace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));
+}
