+function sharedVertexBlockingCells(cells: readonly GridCell[]): ReadonlyMap<string, GridCell> {
+  const normalized = normalizedSightBlockingCells(cells);
+  const signature = sightBlockingSignature(normalized);
+  const cached = sharedVertexBlockingCellMaps.get(signature);
+  if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
+  const blockingKeys = new Set(normalized.map(cellKey));
+  const vertices = new Map<string, GridCell>();
+  const retain = (vertex: CornerPoint, cell: GridCell): void => {
+    const key = cellKey(vertex);
+    const existing = vertices.get(key);
+    if (existing === undefined || compareCells(cell, existing) < 0) vertices.set(key, cell);
+  };
+  for (const top of normalized) {
+    const bottomRight = { column: top.column + 1, row: top.row + 1 };
+    // Here top is TL; a blocking BR seals their shared bottom-right lattice vertex.
+    if (blockingKeys.has(cellKey(bottomRight))) {
+      retain({ column: top.column + 1, row: top.row + 1 }, top);
+    }
+    const bottomLeft = { column: top.column - 1, row: top.row + 1 };
+    // Here top is TR; a blocking BL seals their shared bottom-left lattice vertex.
+    if (blockingKeys.has(cellKey(bottomLeft))) {
+      retain({ column: top.column, row: top.row + 1 }, top);
+    }
+  }
+  sharedVertexBlockingCellMaps.set(signature, vertices);
+  if (sharedVertexBlockingCellMaps.size > EQUIVALENT_TRACE_CACHE_LIMIT) {
+    const oldest = sharedVertexBlockingCellMaps.keys().next().value;
+    if (typeof oldest === 'string') sharedVertexBlockingCellMaps.delete(oldest);
+  }
+  return vertices;
+}
+
+function firstSharedVertexBlockingHit(
+  from: CornerPoint,
+  to: CornerPoint,
+  vertexBlockingCells: ReadonlyMap<string, GridCell>,
+): SightBlockingHit | null {
+  if (![from.column, from.row, to.column, to.row].every(Number.isInteger)) return null;
+  const columnDelta = to.column - from.column;
+  const rowDelta = to.row - from.row;
+  const latticeSteps = greatestCommonDivisor(columnDelta, rowDelta);
+  if (latticeSteps <= 1) return null;
+  const columnStep = columnDelta / latticeSteps;
+  const rowStep = rowDelta / latticeSteps;
+  // Indices exclude t=0 and t=1: endpoint vertices are governed only by cell-interior crossing.
+  for (let index = 1; index < latticeSteps; index += 1) {
+    const column = from.column + columnStep * index;
+    const row = from.row + rowStep * index;
+    const cell = vertexBlockingCells.get(`${String(column)},${String(row)}`);
+    // The precomputed pair winner is lower row then lower column; all-four ties use the same order.
+    if (cell !== undefined) return { cell, progress: index / latticeSteps };
+  }
+  return null;
+}

+function cellInteriorEntryProgress(from: CornerPoint, to: CornerPoint, cell: GridCell): number {
+  let entry = 0;
+  const columnDelta = to.column - from.column;
+  if (columnDelta !== 0) {
+    entry = Math.max(entry, Math.min(
+      (cell.column - from.column) / columnDelta,
+      (cell.column + 1 - from.column) / columnDelta,
+    ));
+  }
+  const rowDelta = to.row - from.row;
+  if (rowDelta !== 0) {

+      (cell.row + 1 - from.row) / rowDelta,
+    ));

--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+
+const actor = playerProfile('wall-probe');
+const state = createEncounter({
+  bounds: { columns: 15, rows: 8 },
+  combatants: [actor],
+  tokens: [placedToken(actor, 14, 7)],
+  blockedCells: [
+    { column: 7, row: 2 }, { column: 7, row: 3 },
+    { column: 8, row: 4 }, { column: 8, row: 5 },
+  ],
+});
+for (const [from, to] of [
+  [{ column: 12, row: 3 }, { column: 0, row: 3 }],
+  [{ column: 12, row: 4 }, { column: 0, row: 4 }],

+  const trace = traceTerrainLine(state, from, to);
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ from, to, sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner, tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: trace.firstBlockingCell,
+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner, tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));
+}
+
+const shifted = createEncounter({

+  blockedCells: [{ column: 3, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 3 }],

+console.log(JSON.stringify({ shifted: true, tier: shiftedTrace.tier, blocksSight: shiftedTrace.blocksSight,
+  firstBlockingCell: shiftedTrace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: shiftedTrace.sourceCorner }));
+
+for (const blockedCells of [
+  [{ column: 1, row: 0 }, { column: 0, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 1, row: 2 }],

+    { column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 },
+    { column: 1, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 2 },

+  const crack = createEncounter({
+    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 }, combatants: [actor], tokens: [placedToken(actor, 4, 4)], blockedCells,
+  });
+  const trace = traceTerrainLine(crack, { column: 0, row: 0 }, { column: 3, row: 3 });
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ blockedCells, tier: trace.tier, blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    firstBlockingCell: trace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));
+}

+function greatestCommonDivisor(left: number, right: number): number {
+  let dividend = Math.abs(left);
+  let divisor = Math.abs(right);
+  while (divisor !== 0) {
+    const remainder = dividend % divisor;
+    dividend = divisor;
+    divisor = remainder;

+  const latticeSteps = greatestCommonDivisor(columnDelta, rowDelta);

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c58bfbaf9c69f0c39750c050f6c84455359dd634
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}
diff --git a//tmp/wall01-generation.ts b//tmp/wall01-generation.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..cf9918a28b3a2e76450b0b0ff2d8e9f0d19aa03a
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-generation.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+  });

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

new file mode 100644

+++ b//tmp/wall01-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+    { column: 8, row: 4 }, { column: 8, row: 5 },
+  ],

+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner, tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));

+

+  blockedCells: [{ column: 3, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 3 }],

+const shiftedTrace = traceTerrainLine(shifted, { column: 0, row: 0 }, { column: 4, row: 4 });
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ shifted: true, tier: shiftedTrace.tier, blocksSight: shiftedTrace.blocksSight,
+  firstBlockingCell: shiftedTrace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: shiftedTrace.sourceCorner }));
+
+for (const blockedCells of [
+  [{ column: 1, row: 0 }, { column: 0, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 1, row: 2 }],
+  [
+    { column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 },
+    { column: 1, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 2 },
+  ],
+]) {
+  const crack = createEncounter({
+    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 }, combatants: [actor], tokens: [placedToken(actor, 4, 4)], blockedCells,
+  });
+  const trace = traceTerrainLine(crack, { column: 0, row: 0 }, { column: 3, row: 3 });
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ blockedCells, tier: trace.tier, blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    firstBlockingCell: trace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));
+}

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+  bounds: { columns: 15, rows: 8 },
+  combatants: [actor],
+  tokens: [placedToken(actor, 14, 7)],

+    { column: 7, row: 2 }, { column: 7, row: 3 },
+    { column: 8, row: 4 }, { column: 8, row: 5 },
+  ],

+for (const [from, to] of [
+  [{ column: 12, row: 3 }, { column: 0, row: 3 }],

+  const trace = traceTerrainLine(state, from, to);
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ from, to, sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner, tier: trace.tier,
+    blocksSight: trace.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: trace.firstBlockingCell,
+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner, tier: line.tier,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));
+}
+
+const shifted = createEncounter({

+  blockedCells: [{ column: 3, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 3 }],
+});
+const shiftedTrace = traceTerrainLine(shifted, { column: 0, row: 0 }, { column: 4, row: 4 });
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ shifted: true, tier: shiftedTrace.tier, blocksSight: shiftedTrace.blocksSight,
+  firstBlockingCell: shiftedTrace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: shiftedTrace.sourceCorner }));
+
+for (const blockedCells of [
+  [{ column: 1, row: 0 }, { column: 0, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }],
+  [{ column: 2, row: 1 }, { column: 1, row: 2 }],
+  [
+    { column: 1, row: 1 }, { column: 2, row: 1 },
+    { column: 1, row: 2 }, { column: 2, row: 2 },
+  ],
+]) {
+  const crack = createEncounter({
+    bounds: { columns: 5, rows: 5 }, combatants: [actor], tokens: [placedToken(actor, 4, 4)], blockedCells,
+  });
+  const trace = traceTerrainLine(crack, { column: 0, row: 0 }, { column: 3, row: 3 });
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ blockedCells, tier: trace.tier, blocksSight: trace.blocksSight,
+    firstBlockingCell: trace.firstBlockingCell, sourceCorner: trace.sourceCorner,
+    lines: trace.lines.map((line) => ({ targetCorner: line.targetCorner,
+      blocksSight: line.blocksSight, firstBlockingCell: line.firstBlockingCell })) }));
+}

function uniqueSources(sources: readonly TerrainLineSource[]): readonly TerrainLineSource[] {
  return sources
    .filter((source, index, all) =>
      all.findIndex((candidate) => taggedSourceId(candidate) === taggedSourceId(source)) === index)
    .sort((left, right) => taggedSourceId(left).localeCompare(taggedSourceId(right)));
}

interface SightBlockingHit {
  readonly cell: GridCell;
  readonly progress: number;
}

function firstSharedEdgeBlockingHit(
  from: CornerPoint,
  to: CornerPoint,
  sightBlockingAt: (cell: GridCell) => boolean,
): SightBlockingHit | null {
  if (from.row === to.row && Number.isInteger(from.row)) {
    const direction = from.column < to.column ? 1 : -1;
    for (
      let column = direction === 1 ? from.column : from.column - 1;
      direction === 1 ? column < to.column : column >= to.column;
      column += direction
    ) {
      const upper = { column, row: from.row - 1 };
      const lower = { column, row: from.row };
      // Deterministic pair choice: the flanking cell with the lower row wins.
      if (sightBlockingAt(upper) && sightBlockingAt(lower)) {
        const entryColumn = direction === 1 ? column : column + 1;
        return { cell: upper, progress: (entryColumn - from.column) / (to.column - from.column) };
      }
    }
  }
  if (from.column === to.column && Number.isInteger(from.column)) {
    const direction = from.row < to.row ? 1 : -1;
    for (
      let row = direction === 1 ? from.row : from.row - 1;
      direction === 1 ? row < to.row : row >= to.row;
      row += direction
    ) {
      const left = { column: from.column - 1, row };
      const right = { column: from.column, row };
      // Deterministic pair choice: the flanking cell with the lower column wins.
      if (sightBlockingAt(left) && sightBlockingAt(right)) {
        const entryRow = direction === 1 ? row : row + 1;
        return { cell: left, progress: (entryRow - from.row) / (to.row - from.row) };
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function greatestCommonDivisor(left: number, right: number): number {
  let dividend = Math.abs(left);
  let divisor = Math.abs(right);
  while (divisor !== 0) {
    const remainder = dividend % divisor;
    dividend = divisor;
    divisor = remainder;
  }
  return dividend;
}

function sharedVertexBlockingCells(cells: readonly GridCell[]): ReadonlyMap<string, GridCell> {
  const blockingKeys = new Set(cells.map(cellKey));
  const vertices = new Map<string, GridCell>();
  const retain = (vertex: CornerPoint, cell: GridCell): void => {
    const key = cellKey(vertex);
    const existing = vertices.get(key);
    if (existing === undefined || compareCells(cell, existing) < 0) vertices.set(key, cell);
  };
  for (const top of cells) {
    const bottomRight = { column: top.column + 1, row: top.row + 1 };
    // Here top is TL; a blocking BR seals their shared bottom-right lattice vertex.
    if (blockingKeys.has(cellKey(bottomRight))) {
      retain({ column: top.column + 1, row: top.row + 1 }, top);
    }
    const bottomLeft = { column: top.column - 1, row: top.row + 1 };
    // Here top is TR; a blocking BL seals their shared bottom-left lattice vertex.
    if (blockingKeys.has(cellKey(bottomLeft))) {
      retain({ column: top.column, row: top.row + 1 }, top);
    }
  }
  return vertices;
}

function firstSharedVertexBlockingHit(
  from: CornerPoint,
  to: CornerPoint,
  vertexBlockingCells: ReadonlyMap<string, GridCell>,
): SightBlockingHit | null {
  if (vertexBlockingCells.size === 0) return null;
  if (![from.column, from.row, to.column, to.row].every(Number.isInteger)) return null;
  const columnDelta = to.column - from.column;
  const rowDelta = to.row - from.row;
  const latticeSteps = greatestCommonDivisor(columnDelta, rowDelta);
  if (latticeSteps <= 1) return null;
  const columnStep = columnDelta / latticeSteps;
  const rowStep = rowDelta / latticeSteps;
  // Indices exclude t=0 and t=1: endpoint vertices are governed only by cell-interior crossing.
  for (let index = 1; index < latticeSteps; index += 1) {
    const column = from.column + columnStep * index;
    const row = from.row + rowStep * index;
    const cell = vertexBlockingCells.get(`${String(column)},${String(row)}`);
    // The precomputed pair winner is lower row then lower column; all-four ties use the same order.
    if (cell !== undefined) return { cell, progress: index / latticeSteps };
  }
  return null;
}

function cellInteriorEntryProgress(from: CornerPoint, to: CornerPoint, cell: GridCell): number {
  let entry = 0;
  const columnDelta = to.column - from.column;
  if (columnDelta !== 0) {
    entry = Math.max(entry, Math.min(
      (cell.column - from.column) / columnDelta,
      (cell.column + 1 - from.column) / columnDelta,
    ));
  }
  const rowDelta = to.row - from.row;
  if (rowDelta !== 0) {
    entry = Math.max(entry, Math.min(
      (cell.row - from.row) / rowDelta,
      (cell.row + 1 - from.row) / rowDelta,
    ));
  }
  return entry;
}

function firstSightBlockingCell(
  from: CornerPoint,
  to: CornerPoint,
  interveningCells: readonly GridCell[],
  sightBlockingAt: (cell: GridCell) => boolean,
  vertexBlockingCells: ReadonlyMap<string, GridCell>,
): GridCell | null {
  let first = firstSharedEdgeBlockingHit(from, to, sightBlockingAt);
  const vertex = firstSharedVertexBlockingHit(from, to, vertexBlockingCells);
  if (vertex !== null && (first === null || vertex.progress < first.progress ||
    (vertex.progress === first.progress && compareCells(vertex.cell, first.cell) < 0))) first = vertex;
  for (const cell of interveningCells) {
    if (!sightBlockingAt(cell)) continue;
    const hit = { cell, progress: cellInteriorEntryProgress(from, to, cell) };
    if (first === null || hit.progress < first.progress ||
      (hit.progress === first.progress && compareCells(hit.cell, first.cell) < 0)) first = hit;
  }
  // One traversal merges cell-interior, shared-edge and strict-interior-vertex events by segment progress.
  // Simultaneous events use lower row, then lower column.
  return first === null ? null : { ...first.cell };
}

function traceCornerLine(
  from: CornerPoint,
  to: CornerPoint,
  candidates: readonly GridCell[],
  sourcesAt: (cell: GridCell) => readonly TerrainLineSource[],
  sightBlockingAt: (cell: GridCell) => boolean,
  vertexBlockingCells: ReadonlyMap<string, GridCell>,
): TerrainCornerLineTrace {
  const interveningCells = rasterizeCornerLine(from, to, candidates);
  let tier: CoverTier = 'none';
  let strongest: TerrainLineSource[] = [];
  const firstBlockingCell = firstSightBlockingCell(
    from,
    to,
    interveningCells,
    sightBlockingAt,
    vertexBlockingCells,
  );
  for (const cell of interveningCells) {
    for (const source of sourcesAt(cell)) {
      const comparison = coverRank(source.tier) - coverRank(tier);
      if (comparison > 0) {
        tier = source.tier;
        strongest = [source];
      } else if (comparison === 0) {
        strongest.push(source);
      }
    }
  }
  const sources = uniqueSources(strongest);
  return {
    targetCorner: { ...to },
    interveningCells,
    tier,
    blocksSight: firstBlockingCell !== null,
    sourceIds: sources.map(taggedSourceId),
    sources,
    firstBlockingCell,

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';

+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({

+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({

+++ b//tmp/wall01-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+import { canonicalJson } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/commands/canonical-json';
+import { sha256 } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/crypto/sha256';
+import { generateRoom } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/room-generator';
+
+const cases = [
+  ...Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 3_943_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'standard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 5_117_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'hard' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}

+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_203_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+  ...Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_unused, index) => ({
+    seed: 6_206_001 + index,
+    difficulty: 'brutal' as const,
+  })),
+];
+
+const rows = cases.map(({ seed, difficulty }) => {
+  const room = difficulty === 'standard' ? generateRoom(seed) : generateRoom(seed, { difficulty });
+  return { seed, difficulty, sha256: sha256(canonicalJson(room)) };
+});
+console.log(JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, aggregateSha256: sha256(canonicalJson(rows)), rows }));

+function greatestCommonDivisor(left: number, right: number): number {

+  const columnStep = columnDelta / latticeSteps;
+  const rowStep = rowDelta / latticeSteps;

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c58bfbaf9c69f0c39750c050f6c84455359dd634
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/wall01-counts.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { decodeArenaFixtureText } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/mcp/entrypoint';
+import {
+  availableEngineActorOptions,
+  resolveEngineActorOption,
+} from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/intent-resolver';
+import { freshMonsterPlanningState } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/monster-planning-state';
+import { buildOfferEnvironment } from '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field/src/vtt/offers/build-offer-environment';
+
+const root = '/home/vagrant/PhpstormProjects/dnd-wt-vis-field';
+const offerEnvironment = buildOfferEnvironment({ kind: 'configuration', mode: 'legacy_standard' });
+const families = [
+  { label: 'hard', directory: 'arena-basis-hard', prefix: '5117', first: 1, last: 13 },
+  { label: 'brutal', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal', prefix: '6203', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-b', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-b', prefix: '6206', first: 1, last: 10 },
+  { label: 'brutal-2', directory: 'arena-basis-brutal-2', prefix: '6207', first: 1, last: 10 },
+] as const;
+
+for (const family of families) {
+  let monsters = 0;
+  let offers = 0;
+  let shotless = 0;
+  for (let suffix = family.first; suffix <= family.last; suffix += 1) {
+    const seed = `${family.prefix}${String(suffix).padStart(3, '0')}`;
+    const path = resolve(root, 'tests/fixtures', family.directory, `seed-${seed}.json`);
+    const state = freshMonsterPlanningState(decodeArenaFixtureText(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')));
+    const living = state.combatants.filter((combatant) =>
+      combatant.profile.kind === 'monster' && combatant.life === 'living');
+    monsters += living.length;
+    for (const monster of living) {
+      let hasAttack = false;
+      for (const option of availableEngineActorOptions(
+        state,
+        monster.profile.id,
+        offerEnvironment,
+        state.revision,
+      )) {
+        const resolution = resolveEngineActorOption(state, option, offerEnvironment);
+        if (!resolution.valid) throw new Error(`${path}: unresolved ${option.optionId}`);
+        const hasAttackOrSave = resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) =>
+          use.kind === 'attack' || use.kind === 'saving_throw');
+        if (hasAttackOrSave) {
+          offers += 1;
+        }
+        if (resolution.mechanics.actionSlots.some((use) => use.kind === 'attack')) hasAttack = true;
+      }
+      if (!hasAttack) shotless += 1;
+    }
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ family: family.label, monsters, offers, shotless }));
+}
